mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points month-over-month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by > 0.3pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, it signals a favorable environment for corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 12mo MA and FEDFUNDS < 3%.
